A healthy dish made by cooking mixed greens over a strong flame.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Copious Fried Wild Greens are made by [[Cooking]] four different [[Vegetable]]s, herbs, or [[Flower]]s together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they will restore several [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. They are known to be healthy [[Meal]]s made by cooking mixed greens over a strong flame. Due to the variety and number of ingredients needed to make Copious Fried Wild Greens, only their default version is available. It is impossible to add any effects to this dish. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Copious Fried Wild Greens reappear in {{TotK}}. Due to the addition of [[Korok Frond]]s acting as a neutral [[Cooking]] [[Ingredient]], it is possible to make five variations of the [[Meal]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The recipe for Copious Fried Wild Greens is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[A Feast of Greens]]". It is made using one [[Hyrule Herb]], one [[Swift Violet]], one [[Mighty Thistle]], one [[Armoranth]], and one [[Blue Nightshade]]. When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Perfect Dodging|Perfect-Dodge]] timing window increases by 5% for the [[Warrior]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Copious Fried Wild Greens Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Copious Fried Wild Greens icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Fried Wild Greens * Meal * Salt-Grilled Greens }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Fries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
